title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
reasoning: The paper evaluates Large Language Model alignment through benchmarks like BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) and TruthfulQA. BBQ specifically contains a 'Religion' category to test for bias related to faith and spiritual traditions. Furthermore, the paper aims to improve 'truthfulness' and 'fairness', and its qualitative analysis explicitly addresses 'principles of human rights and basic morality'.
